title: 第20章 城主府来人
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“砰砰砰。”

    林奇正端着碗喝粥时，一阵急促的敲门声突然响起。

    “谁啊？”

    林峰放下木勺，朝院门口扬声喊道：“现在还没到营业时间呢！”

    门外传来一道带着几分肃穆的女声：“开门，城主府的人。”

    “城主府？”

    林峰的动作顿住，脸上露出疑惑。

    “难不成又要去剿贼了，要交剿贼税？”

    他刚要起身去开门就被林奇一把按住手腕。

    “爹，你不用去，他们是找我的。”

    林奇放下碗，擦了擦嘴。

    怕林峰担心，又补充道：“上次你被强盗扣押，我就是找城主的女儿艾丽西亚帮忙的。”

    “小姐？”

    林峰一脸懵逼，显然没想到自己儿子这么牛，竟然和城主闺女都有牵扯。

    “走了，风铃。”

    林奇朝风铃猫招了招手，小家伙立刻会意，轻巧地跳到他身旁，尾巴一甩一甩的，跟着他走向门口。

    “没想到艾丽西亚这么快就按耐不住了。”

    帮艾丽西亚找粉萤石的事情他一直都记得，并且任务已经完成。

    但林奇不着急给她送去。

    自己主动送去那是狗腿子行为，而要等着对方来找自己，那最起码还是对方有求于他。

    只是他没想到，艾丽西亚给自己两个星期的时间，这才刚第十天就等不及催进度了。
content_en:
"Bang bang bang."

While Lin Qi was drinking porridge from a bowl, there was a sudden knock on the door.

"Who?"

Lin Feng put down the wooden spoon and shouted towards the courtyard door: "It's not even business hours yet!"

A somewhat solemn female voice came from outside the door: "Open the door, someone from the City Lord's Mansion."

"City Lord's Mansion?"

Lin Feng paused in his movements, with confusion on his face.

"Is it possible that we are going to suppress bandits again and have to pay the bandit suppression tax?"

Just as he was about to get up and open the door, Lynch held his wrist down.

"Dad, you don't have to go, they are looking for me."

Lynch put down the bowl and wiped his mouth.

Afraid that Lin Feng would be worried, he added: "Last time you were detained by robbers, I asked the city lord's daughter Alicia for help."

"Miss?"

Lin Feng looked confused. He obviously didn't expect that his son was so awesome and would be involved with the city lord's daughter.

"Let's go, Wind Chime."

Lin Qi waved to the wind chime cat, and the little guy immediately understood, jumped up to him lightly, swung his tail, and followed him towards the door.

"I didn't expect Alicia to lose control so quickly."

He had always remembered helping Alicia find pink fluorite, and the task had been completed.

But Lynch was in no hurry to send it to her.

It would be a stupid act to take the initiative to send it by yourself, but if you have to wait for the other party to come to you, then at least the other party will want something from him.

But he didn't expect that Alicia would give him two weeks, and it was only the tenth day and she couldn't wait to make progress.
